title: Smoothness of the explicit separable-preparation quotient
statement: Let k be a field and A a finitely presented k-algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra]. Let d,n,m be natural numbers with n≥1 and a:Fin m→A generate H_{A/k} [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]. Set R=k[X_i | i∈Fin d] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] and B=A[X_i,Z_ij]/(X_i^n−Σ_j Z_ij a_j), with its R-algebra structure sending X_i to its class. Then B is finitely presented over R; every B_(a_j) and every B_(X_i) is smooth over R [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

proof.text: The finitely generated relation ideal is the span of a finite range. The polynomial ring over A is finitely presented over k by Mathlib instances, and its quotient is finitely presented by FinitePresentation.quotient. The base evaluation map commutes with k, giving a scalar tower. Since k[X_i] is finite type over k, FinitePresentation.of_restrict_scalars_finitePresentation gives finite presentation over k[X_i].

Each generator a_j lies in the singular ideal by the span equality. Apply smooth_localization_of_mem_singularIdeal to A_(a_j), then popescuPolynomialCoefficientLocalization_smooth to obtain smoothness of B_(a_j).

In B_(X_i), map the quotient relation X_i^n=Σ_j Z_(i,j)a_j. The left side is a unit, and the right side lies in the ideal spanned by the images of a_j, so that ideal is top. Localize each smooth B_(a_j) at X_i. The two iterated localizations are both localizations of B at X_i*a_j, giving a canonical equivalence over k[X_i]. Transport smoothness and apply smooth_of_localization_span_universes on the resulting cover. Empty families and zero rings are handled by the same unit-in-ideal proof. The positive exponent hypothesis is unnecessary for this argument but its binder is unchanged.
